claims: Valero Energy Corporation is a San Antonio-based Fortune 500 company.
Valero Energy Corporation is the world's largest independent petroleum refiner.
Valero Energy Corporation operates 12 ethanol plants.
Valero Energy Corporation operates 15 refineries across the U.S., Canada, and the U.K.
Valero Energy Corporation's refineries have a total throughput capacity of about 3.2 million barrels per day.
Valero Energy Corporation is a top producer of renewable diesel via its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture.
Valero Energy Corporation manufactures gasoline including TOP TIER™.
Valero Energy Corporation manufactures jet fuel.
Valero Energy Corporation is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas.
Valero Energy Corporation has nearly 10,000 employees.
Valero Energy Corporation is the title sponsor of the Valero Texas Open.
The Valero Texas Open is a PGA Tour event
